sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Pongball is a game of skill and strategy, where players must control their paddle to score epic goals against their opponent. The game's controls are simple yet intuitive, allowing players to use their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to play. With each goal scored, the opponent's strength increases, challenging the player to adapt their strategy to overcome the growing opponent. The game's scoring system is based on the number of goals scored, with the player earning points for each goal. The player's objective is to score as many goals as possible within the allotted game time or to outscore their opponent.

One of the standout features of Pongball is its responsive controls, which allow players to react quickly to changing situations on the field. The game's physics engine ensures that the ball behaves realistically, taking into account factors such as speed, direction, and bounce. This results in a more immersive and engaging gameplay experience, as players must anticipate and respond to the ball's trajectory to score goals.

The game also features a variety of power-ups and boosts that can be used to gain a strategic advantage over the opponent. These power-ups can be earned through successful gameplay or purchased using in-game currency. Players can use these power-ups to enhance their paddle's speed, increase their scoring potential, or temporarily stun their opponent. The strategic use of these power-ups can be the difference between victory and defeat, adding a new layer of complexity to the game's core mechanics.
